entries.title: Job 6:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 6:2
segments: "Oh, that my grief were fully weighed, And my calamity laid with it on the scales!

entries.title: Job 6:3
segments: For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea-Therefore my words have been rash.

entries.title: Job 6:4
segments: For the arrows of the Almighty [are] within me; My spirit drinks in their poison; The terrors of God are arrayed against me.

entries.title: Job 6:5
segments: Does the wild donkey bray when it has grass, Or does the ox low over its fodder?

entries.title: Job 6:6
segments: Can flavorless food be eaten without salt? Or is there [any] taste in the white of an egg?

entries.title: Job 6:7
segments: My soul refuses to touch them; They [are] as loathsome food to me.

entries.title: Job 6:8
segments: ¶"Oh, that I might have my request, That God would grant [me] the thing that I long for!

entries.title: Job 6:9
segments: That it would please God to crush me, That He would loose His hand and cut me off!

entries.title: Job 6:10
segments: Then I would still have comfort; Though in anguish, I would exult, He will not spare; For I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

entries.title: Job 6:11
segments: "What strength do I have, that I should hope? And what [is] my end, that I should prolong my life?

entries.title: Job 6:12
segments: [Is] my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh bronze?

entries.title: Job 6:13
segments: [Is] my help not within me? And is success driven from me?

entries.title: Job 6:14
segments: ¶"To him who is afflicted, kindness [should be shown] by his friend, Even though he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 6:15
segments: My brothers have dealt deceitfully like a brook, Like the streams of the brooks that pass away,

entries.title: Job 6:16
segments: Which are dark because of the ice, [And] into which the snow vanishes.

entries.title: Job 6:17
segments: When it is warm, they cease to flow; When it is hot, they vanish from their place.

entries.title: Job 6:18
segments: The paths of their way turn aside, They go nowhere and perish.

entries.title: Job 6:19
segments: The caravans of Tema look, The travelers of Sheba hope for them.

entries.title: Job 6:20
segments: They are disappointed because they were confident; They come there and are confused.

entries.title: Job 6:21
segments: For now you are nothing, You see terror and are afraid.

entries.title: Job 6:22
segments: ¶Did I ever say, 'Bring [something] to me'? Or, 'Offer a bribe for me from your wealth'?

entries.title: Job 6:23
segments: Or, 'Deliver me from the enemy's hand'? Or, 'Redeem me from the hand of oppressors'?

entries.title: Job 6:24
segments: "Teach me, and I will hold my tongue; Cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

entries.title: Job 6:25
segments: How forceful are right words! But what does your arguing prove?

entries.title: Job 6:26
segments: Do you intend to rebuke [my] words, And the speeches of a desperate one, [which are] as wind?

entries.title: Job 6:27
segments: Yes, you overwhelm the fatherless, And you undermine your friend.

entries.title: Job 6:28
segments: Now therefore, be pleased to look at me; For I would never lie to your face.

entries.title: Job 6:29
segments: Yield now, let there be no injustice! Yes, concede, my righteousness still stands!

entries.title: Job 6:30
segments: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern the unsavory?
